name: Hosea
title: Hosea — Loyal Love to the Unfaithful
purpose: Expose harlotry; display God’s pursuing hesed.
christ: Faithful Husband; “out of Egypt I called my son” (11:1 → Matt 2).
spirit: Knowledge of God more than sacrifice — Spirit-wrought fidelity.
jesus_in_this_book: Faithful Husband; “out of Egypt I called my son” (11:1 → Matt 2).
how_to_read: Feel the marriage metaphor without blunting the charge of sin.
watchman_charge: Stop whoring after other loves. Return to the LORD.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
